classification.summary: KiloEx's MinimalForwarder.execute() let any caller supply both the forwarded `from` address and a signature that its verification accepted, so the attacker impersonated the privileged price keeper and called setPrices() on the KiloEx price feed, opening and closing a position across a self-set price.

loss.notes: Migrated from legacy lossUsd/lossOther. The legacy corpus did not consistently distinguish gross from net loss or record valuation provenance.

sources.note: callTracer review of the Base attack tx: the attacker contract 0xd649a087... calls 0x3274b668... with selector 0x47153f82 (MinimalForwarder.execute), which delegatecalls impl 0xbed75e25a63d2be11605038921aa5eef78bb4e61 and then calls the price feed 0xfdc7bc3a... with 0xac9fd279 (setPrices); the forwarder proxy was created by KiloEx deployer 0x1d568fc08a1d3978985bc3e896a22abd1222abcf, not by the attacker (public writeups often point at the attacker-deployed 0xd649a087... instead)
